Can the counters be used to prevent dammages done by thaumaturgy cards
like blood fury or blood rage ?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Arnaud Clavel <Arnaud...@renault.com> wrote:
> Can the counters be used to prevent dammages done by thaumaturgy cards
> like blood fury or blood rage ?

Ablative Skin [SAB] - Action (for)

* Cannot be used to prevent damage that cannot be prevented by
cards that require Fortitude (e.g., Blood Rage and Blood Fury).
[LSJ 16-FEB-1999]
